result.description: A fictional desktop sound sculptor designed for experimental ambient composition and live drone layering. The TidalPen H7 features dual oscillator banks, granular texture mapping, a touch-sensitive ribbon strip, and a compact aluminum chassis built for studio routing and performance improvisation. It is positioned as a creative audio instrument rather than a computing or storage product, with emphasis on tonal generation, modulation depth, and hands-on control.
result.title: NoriWave TidalPen H7 Ambient Synth Module
result.title_description: Compact ambient synth module with ribbon control and granular sound design
